scripts.dev: bash -c 'YTDLP=$(ls /nix/store/*-yt-dlp-2025*/bin/yt-dlp /nix/store/*-yt-dlp-2024*/bin/yt-dlp 2>/dev/null | sort -rV | head -1); [ -n "$YTDLP" ] && ln -sf "$YTDLP" /tmp/replit-yt-dlp && echo "[setup] yt-dlp symlink: /tmp/replit-yt-dlp -> $YTDLP" || echo "[setup] yt-dlp not found in nix store, will fall back to PATH"' && export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
